description: Source file implementing functions to create and handle error response messages in a USP (Universal Service Platform) context, including creation of error messages, adding parameter errors, and calculating outer error codes.

methods.name: ERROR_RESP_CreateSingle
methods.description: Creates a simple error response message with a single error message, freeing the source message if provided.

methods.name: ERROR_RESP_Create
methods.description: Creates a USP error message with specified message ID, error code, and error message.

methods.name: ERROR_RESP_AddParamError
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an existing error message, allocating and initializing a new param error object.

methods.name: ERROR_RESP_CalcOuterErrCode
methods.description: Determines the outer error code based on the inner error code, especially for invalid argument related errors.
